blocks.name: Validate fresh platform, frozen source and exact approved packet
blocks.text:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
if ($env:RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT -cne 'github-hosted' -or -not [Environment]::Is64BitProcess -or
    [Environment]::OSVersion.Version.Build -ne 20348 -or
    [IO.DriveInfo]::new('C:\').DriveFormat -cne 'NTFS' -or
    $env:EXPECTED_PACKET_SHA256 -cnotmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') { throw 'Fixed fresh-platform/packet prerequisite not met.' }
$env:GO = (Get-Command go -CommandType Application).Source
python build-bundle.py
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Fixed source build failed; no setup.' }
$digest = (Get-FileHash artifacts\manifest.json -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
if ($digest -cne $env:EXPECTED_PACKET_SHA256) { throw 'Approved immutable packet differs; no setup or fallback.' }
"packet_ready=true" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
Write-Output 'Fixed source and packet verified. No Windows service created.'

blocks.name: Parse controller and compile declarations without invoking setup
Prepare only the approved new observation service
blocks.text:
powershell.exe -NoProfile -File artifacts\Invoke-ProtectionProbe.ps1 -Phase Prepare -ExpectedPacketSha256 $env:EXPECTED_PACKET_SHA256 *> "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\system-observation-prepare.private.log"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Prepare failed; partial state retained, no retry.' }
"prepared=true" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
Write-Output 'Prepared one owned stopped service; no start yet.'

blocks.name: Consume and run once, preserving controller output privately
Collect only receipt-proved owned resources
blocks.text:
powershell.exe -NoProfile -File artifacts\Invoke-ProtectionProbe.ps1 -Phase Cleanup -ExpectedPacketSha256 $env:EXPECTED_PACKET_SHA256 *> "$env:RUNNER_TEMP\system-observation-cleanup.private.log"
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Cleanup unconfirmed; retain failure and disposable VM containment.' }
"collected=true" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
Write-Output 'Owned registration/files collected; private evidence remains only in this VM.'

blocks.name: Emit bounded anonymous observations only
Preserve honest outcome without exporting raw artifacts
blocks.text:
Write-Output 'No raw report, SID/SDDL/LUID/PID, private controller log, binary artifact or cache is uploaded.'
Write-Output 'Provider VM disposal is containment, never physical-stop or protected-native acceptance.'
